node.text: 已解出 45 题 · 作文范文 2 篇

21. Which team will play the most games at the stadium this month? A. Washington Commanders. B. Los Angeles Rams. C. Los Angeles Chargers. D. New Orleans Saints. 答案：B 文中明确说Rams每个赛季在此主场作战次数最多。
22. Which hotel is the nearest to the stadium? A. Sonder Lum Hotel. B. The Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles. C. The H Hotel Los Angeles. D. The Renaissance LA Airport Hotel 答案：A Sonder Lum Hotel就在体育场街对面，距离最近。
23. What do you need to do if you want to park at the stadium? A. Call the parking staff. B. Prepay the parking fee. C. Obtain a parking pass. D. Choose a parking zone. 答案：C 文中建议通过ParkWhiz提前购买停车通行证。
24. What does Kevin usually do to get the meaning of a word? A. Use electronic devices. B. Consult a paper dictionary. C. Guess from the context. D. Turn to his English teacher. 答案：B Kevin习惯翻阅纸质词典查词义。
25. How did Kevin feel while looking up the word in the dictionary? A. Annoyed. B. Disappointed. C. Encouraged. D. Astonished. 答案：D 他发现整页都是相同开头字母的词，感到震惊又敬畏。
26. What can we learn about the author's first dictionary? A. It helped her through the college. B. It was given to Kevin as a gift. C. It bore witness to her efforts. D. It was a valuable limited edition. 答案：C 作者在词典上逐条做标记，词典见证了她的努力。
27. What has the author come to realize about learning? A. It is never too late to start. B. Motivation is what really matters. C. Children need role models. D. Dictionaries are still a useful tool. 答案：B 作者强调自己查词是出于兴趣和体验，说明内在动机最重要。
28. What does the new study imply regarding oaks and sweetgums? A. They affect the growth of other trees. B. They absorb less carbon than expected. C. They harm people's health indirectly. D. They raise the local temperature slowly. 答案：C 橡树和枫香树释放的异戊二烯与氮氧化物生成臭氧，间接危害健康。
29. Which of the following may Commane suggest based on their study? A. Cutting down the isoprene-producing trees. B. Suspending tree-planting for a few decades. C. Changing the species of trees in new plantings. D. Removing isoprene released by existing trees. 答案：C Commane表示种树要谨慎，暗示应改变新植树的树种。
30. What does the underlined phrase "oblivious to" in paragraph 5 mean? A. Honest about. B. Unaware of. C. Related to. D. Optimistic about. 答案：B oblivious to意为“未意识到”，与unaware of同义。
31. What would Auyeung probably advocate? A. Reducing car use in daily life. B. Providing animals with new habitats. C. Controlling population growth. D. Doing more research on the problem. 答案：A Auyeung认为问题在汽车尾气，应减少日常用车。
32. What does the study imply regarding oaks and sweetgums? A. They attract more native insects. B. They absorb less carbon dioxide. C. They suffer from a hotter climate. D. They pose the same threat to us. 答案：D 研究指出这些树产生的臭氧同样威胁人类健康。
33. According to the study, which group was more likely to think beyond daily life? A. Existing trees will gradually disappear. B. A longer dry season is approaching. C. A hotter climate is approaching. D. Existing trees will be replaced by new ones. 答案：C 研究显示若维持现有树种，夏季臭氧会升高，气候更炎热。
34. What is the author's attitude towards the parks' current tree species? A. Favorable. B. Indifferent. C. Disapproving. D. Ambiguous. 答案：C 作者引用研究说明现有树种可能恶化空气质量，持不赞成态度。
35. What does the study encourage people to do? A. Visit galleries more often. B. Spend less time on screens. C. Buy handmade ceramics. D. Develop their critical thinking. 答案：A 研究显示欣赏艺术之美能促进抽象思维，鼓励人们多去美术馆。
36. 36__________. 答案：E 空格后讲AI如何改变博物馆体验，E句“博物馆一直是重要的学习场所”可作段首引入。
37. 37__________ Virtual guides can respond in dozens of languages and adjust their tone to suit each listener, whether a young student or a lifelong art lover. 答案：F 后文讲虚拟导览能多语言回应，F句“AI聊天机器人正取代传统语音导览”衔接自然。
38. 38__________ Moreover, it can predict how a fragile painting may age over the years, allowing experts to step in before any visible damage appears. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：A 后文讲AI能预测画作老化，A句“这些能力使AI成为修复艺术的有力工具”承上启下。
39. 39__________ For instance, a curious child and a trained art expert standing before the same painting might each receive a completely different guided tour. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：D 后文举例不同观众获得不同导览，D句“它针对不同年龄和学习风格定制推荐”相符。
40. 40________ Strict rules are therefore needed to ensure that every visitor's privacy is fully protected. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：B 后文说需要严格规则保护隐私，B句“访客数据若被滥用会引发隐私问题”衔接。
41. The 41______ that people only really knew Ohio for the three C's - Cleveland, Cincinnati, or Columbus (not Cortland!) - came quickly when I decided to go to school in central Pennsylvania. A. fantasy B. prejudice C. realization D. expectation 答案：C “意识到人们只知俄亥俄三C”是一种认识，选realization。
42. Half of my peers didn't even realize I lived a 42 ______ three and a half hours away. A. only B. indeed C. still D. even 答案：A 强调“仅仅三个半小时车程”，用only。
43. The 43 ______ are never-ending. A. tests B. questions C. games D. debates 答案：B 后文列举各种提问，说明问题没完没了，选questions。
44. I was a unicorn in their eyes, a 44 ______ Or, on second thought, maybe just a country hick. A. success B. victim C. novelty D. problem 答案：C “unicorn”指稀罕新奇之物，novelty（新奇事物）符合语境。
45. As I grow older, I'm more and more 45 ______ for my small town roots. A. thankful B. hopeful C. suitable D. reliable 答案：A be thankful for意为“感激”，与后文grateful呼应。
46. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. dream B. lie C. bear D. complain 答案：D complain about how bored we were 抱怨无聊，符合语境。
47. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. therefore B. however C. instead D. otherwise 答案：B 前后为转折关系，用however。
48. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. touring B. challenging C. leaving D. protecting 答案：C “离开小镇后才意识到多爱它”，选leaving。
49. For one, the pace of life isn't anxiety provoking and people really 49 ______ connecting to each other. A. value B. admit C. fear D. remember 答案：A 小镇人重视彼此联系，value意为“珍视”。
50. That means that you do more than just talk to your next door neighbors - in a lot of cases, they're truly so 50 ______ of your family. A. advantage B. example C. owner D. extension 答案：D 邻居如同家庭的延伸，extension符合。
51. So much of this 51______ revolves around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town, being present and mindful of your 52______ is a critical part of the culture. A. lifestyle B. landscape C. procedure D. personality 答案：A 这种生活方式围绕户外活动，lifestyle最贴切。
52. So much of this 51______ revolves around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town, being present and mindful of your 52______ is a critical part of the culture. A. findings B. surroundings C. belongings D. greetings 答案：B 留意周围环境是文化的一部分，surroundings意为“周围环境”。
53. As I move through my college years, I 53 ______ the visits to my little hometown. A. give up B. put off C. face up to D. look forward to 答案：D look forward to the visits 期待回乡探访。
54. I am grateful for the 54 ______ that I had growing up and know that wherever my next adventure takes me, I can 55 ______ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction. 答案：B grateful for the example 感激成长中得到的榜样。
55. I am grateful for the 54 ______ that I had growing up and know that wherever my next adventure takes me, I can 55 ______ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction. 答案：A 让小镇根基引领方向，rely on符合语境。
56. It is also common for them 56 ____ (hold) on traditional Chinese holidays such as the Spring Festival, also known as the Chinese New Year, and Mid-Autumn Festival, as well as other local festivals. 答案：to hold be common for sb to do sth，用不定式。
57. The exact dates and 57 ____ (frequent) of daji vary from region to region. 答案：frequency 与dates并列作主语，需名词形式。
58. Dajis evolved from the folk custom of trading goods, which can be traced back to 58 ____ Han Dynasty (202 B.C.-A.D. 答案：the Han Dynasty为特指朝代，加定冠词。
59. In the old days, transportation and communication 59 ____ (be) so poor that it was challenging for households to exchange items to meet their needs for daily 60 ____ (necessity). 答案：were 主语为transportation and communication，过去时用were。
60. In the old days, transportation and communication 59 ____ (be) so poor that it was challenging for households to exchange items to meet their needs for daily 60 ____ (necessity). 答案：necessities daily necessities日常必需品，用复数。
61. They would trade their surplus items 61 ____ the goods they needed. 答案：for trade A for B 用……换……。
62. 62____ (Draw) by the enticing aromas, they hurry to food stalls, 63____ steamed dumplings and hot noodle soups. 答案：Drawn 过去分词作状语，表被动“被吸引”。
63. 62____ (Draw) by the enticing aromas, they hurry to food stalls, 63____ steamed dumplings and hot noodle soups. 答案：grabbing 现在分词作伴随状语，与hurry并列。
64. Before 64 ____ (head) back home, they purchase some fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, which are much 65 ____ (cheap)than those in supermarkets, and embark on their journey back home. 答案：heading before后接动名词，before heading back home。
65. Before 64 ____ (head) back home, they purchase some fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, which are much 65 ____ (cheap)than those in supermarkets, and embark on their journey back home. 答案：cheaper much修饰比较级，cheaper than。
